notes:
Inbound SMB lead — onboarding via hosted API trial. Customer is an ecommerce personalization startup (cart/checkout micro-experiments).
Quick bullets from discovery:
- Wants to use hosted API for chat/SOP assistant and embedding-based product recommendations.
- Primary concern: are prompts (customer-provided text) stored? Do they count toward analytics logs? How long are logs retained by default?
- Wants an opt-out for storing prompts tied to end-customer consent; asks if we can disable storage per API key.
- Also asked for ability to purge all their prompts and generated outputs on demand (DSR/Right to be forgotten).
- Cost sensitivity: low-latency small-batch inference for personalization (p95 < 250ms), budget-minded (looking to stay under $2k/mo initially).
- Model preference: open models (Llama variants) OK if latency/cost good; otherwise Redwood-managed curated model OK.
- Security asks: SSO for staff, audit logs for admin changes, retention controls and clear SLA for deletion.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We need to be sure we can delete PII on demand — otherwise legal won't let us ship."
- Suggested default: 30-day application logs + 7-day short-term cache for latency protections; they want opt-in longer retention for analytics.
- Actionables: provide a short FAQ that lists: default retention windows, how prompts are used (improve models? — currently no for hosted API by default), how to opt-out, delete endpoint (example curl), and sample legal language for contracts.
- POC plan: 2-week trial using hosted API keys (Jordan to provision rate-limited keys), deploy to staging, run 10k user events, evaluate latency/cost and test deletion flow.
- Internal notes: escalate to Legal/Privacy for final deletion SLA; SE to draft example DSR API snippet and test with their sample dataset.
- Good signals: engaged engineering CTO, 2-week timeline to decision, willing to do self-serve but needs written retention guarantees.
